title: Chinese Exclusion Act
summary: Signed on 6 May 1882, the Act banned immigration of Chinese labourers. It was the first major US law to bar all members of a specific national group and was repealed only in 1943.
why: The first US immigration law to target a specific nationality.

notes.problem: Drops the source's qualifier: 'the first major US law implemented to prevent all members of a specific national group from immigrating' (the 1875 Page Act came earlier).
